scope: Six-point follow-up, isolated synthetic data only; original optimization results remain in native-php-optimizations.json
notes: SQLite runs are consecutive, 15 warm shuffled samples each per scenario and mode, profiling disabled for primary measurements.
MariaDB uses five samples per variant: functional validation, exploratory performance only.
Helper benchmark is separate: 21 shuffled samples of three iterations, with exact before/after output assertions.
No uniform whole-page gain established; mixed medians and high variable tails. No HTTP, concurrency or production validation.
All 16 timing-stripped profile comparisons pass in every run. Run 1 checked independently; integrated harness assertions run in SQLite 2 and MariaDB.
A first intermediate fullstack run and an earlier helper run are excluded from this final dataset.
